question: Can you give me an overview of our website traffic for December 2020? I'm particularly interested in the channel with the fourth highest number of sessions.
sql:
WITH sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    DISTINCT 
    event_date,
    SAFE_CAST(
      (SELECT value.int_value FROM UNNEST(event_params) WHERE key = 'ga_session_id')
      AS STRING
    ) AS session_id,
    traffic_source.medium,
    traffic_source.source,
    traffic_source.name
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ga4_obfuscated_sample_ecommerce.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20201201' AND '20201231'
),
channel_grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    session_id,
    CASE
      WHEN source = '(direct)' AND medium IN ('(not set)', '(none)') THEN 'Direct'
      WHEN source IN ('google', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'yahoo', 'yandex', 'baidu') AND medium IN ('cpc', 'ppc', 'paid') THEN 'Paid Search'
      WHEN source IN ('google', 'bing', 'duckduckgo', 'ecosia', 'yahoo', 'yandex', 'baidu') AND medium = 'organic' THEN 'Organic Search'
      WHEN medium = 'referral' THEN 'Referral'
      WHEN medium = 'email' OR source LIKE '%email%' OR source LIKE '%e-mail%' OR source LIKE '%e_mail%' OR source LIKE '%e mail%' THEN 'Email'
      WHEN medium = 'affiliate' THEN 'Affiliates'
      WHEN medium = 'audio' THEN 'Audio'
      WHEN medium LIKE '%push' OR (medium LIKE '%mobile%' AND medium NOT IN ('<Other>')) OR (medium LIKE '%notification%' AND medium NOT IN ('<Other>')) THEN 'Mobile Push Notifications'
      WHEN source = 'sms' OR medium = 'sms' THEN 'SMS'
      WHEN medium IN ('display', 'banner', 'expandable', 'interstitial', 'cpm') THEN 'Display'
      WHEN medium IN ('social', 'social-network', 'social-media', 'sm', 'social network', 'social media') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN source IN ('facebook', 'fb', 'instagram', 'linkedin', 'pinterest', 'twitter', 'tiktok', 'badoo', 'whatsapp') AND medium IN ('cpc', 'ppc', 'paid') THEN 'Paid Social'
      WHEN source IN ('youtube', 'vimeo', 'dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'twitch') AND medium IN ('cpc', 'ppc', 'paid') THEN 'Paid Video'
      WHEN source IN ('facebook', 'fb', 'instagram', 'linkedin', 'pinterest', 'twitter', 'tiktok', 'badoo', 'whatsapp') THEN 'Organic Social'
      WHEN source IN ('youtube', 'vimeo', 'dailymotion', 'disneyplus', 'netflix', 'twitch') THEN 'Organic Video'
      WHEN source IN ('alibaba', 'amazon', 'google shopping', 'shopify', 'etsy', 'ebay', 'stripe', 'walmart') THEN 'Organic Shopping'
      ELSE 'Unassigned'
    END AS channel
  FROM sessions
)
SELECT 
  channel,
  COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions
FROM channel_grouped
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY sessions DESC
